sqlalchemy nullable datetime column mapp.question: sqlalchemy nullable datetime column mapped optional
sqlalchemy nullable datetime column mapp.answer: Declare the attribute as Mapped[datetime | None] and pass nullable=True to mapped_column. SQLAlchemy 2.0 infers nullability from the Optional annotation, but stating nullable=True keeps the DDL explicit and survives a change to the annotation.

AttributeError: 'SalesTask' object has n.answer: The mapped class does not declare the column. Add the mapped_column to the model, then recreate the tables or run a migration. On SQLite an existing file keeps the old schema, so a stale database reproduces this after the model is fixed.
